exposure: early pregnancy inflammatory indices (systemic immune-inflammation index (SII))
early pregnancy inflammatory indices (systemic inflammation response index (SIRI))
cohort: The study included 140 women with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PREGDM) and 140 age-matched controls.
finding: Early pregnancy inflammatory indices were associated with preterm birth in univariate analyses but lost significance after adjustment for maternal and metabolic risk factors; HbA1c and parity were the only independent predictors of adverse outcomes in PREGDM pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more frequent in pregnancies complicated by pregestational diabetes.
